correctness.rationale: Hasse--Taylor expansion modulo t³ proves the exact fiber function form; CRT for (X-a)³ glues independent jets; injectivity of quadratic evaluation for \(q>2\) and the \(s^2=s\) binary identity give \(q^5\) or 16 local functions. Functional idempotence forces the linear first coordinate coefficient alpha to be 0 or 1, and then forces the entire fixed fiber map to be constant or identity. These exhaustive alternatives yield the per-image multiplicity and full generating formula. Explicit exhaustive F₂ enumeration of all 1024 polynomial self-functions and \(\mathbb F_2,\mathbb F_3,\mathbb F_4\) local jet checks agree. Finite enumeration is auxiliary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first chain-ring nilpotence length with a genuinely nonzero radical square gives an exact and natural retraction-image spectrum for every finite field, rather than a small-case census. The quadratic jet introduces an arithmetic exception at \(q=2\); the result determines every image subset, exact number of retractions onto it, and sharp extremal ranks, a structural-enumerative invariant relevant to finite polynomial transformation monoids. It is neither a renaming of an old ring nor a numerical substitution into a square-zero theorem.
